title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Activation Cover Days Added for Late Payment Charges
content:
For the PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) activation payment, the cover days are increased according to the late payment charges billed on the enrolled service account in its Electric Service by Rate Schedule records during the twelve-month window.

| Late payment charges billed on the enrolled service account in the twelve-month window | Cover days |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | increased by 3 |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | increased by 1 |
| none | not increased for late charges |

**Clause.** Where at least 3 late payment charges were billed on the enrolled service account in the twelve-month window, the cover days are increased by 3; where at least one but fewer than 3 were, the cover days are increased by 1; with none the cover days are not increased for late charges.

**Window.** A month window of a stated number of months covers the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, up to and including the current date.

**Notes (hypothetical counts).** Two late payment charges in the window increase the cover days by 1; a third raises the increase to 3. Late charges on another service account of the member are not counted.
